52776-x-marks-the-pedwalk.title: X Marks The Pedwalk
52776-x-marks-the-pedwalk.creator: Unknown
52776-x-marks-the-pedwalk.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Smythe-de Winter, the driver, wasn't happy. The little old lady's last shot had taken two members of his car pool. Bursting through the laminated glass, the steel-jacketed slug had traversed the neck of Phipps-McHeath and buried itself in the skull of Horvendile-Harker.

arxiv-2106-00227.title: VA-GCN: A Vector Attention Graph Convolution Network for learning on Point Clouds
arxiv-2106-00227.creator: Haotian Hu, Fanyi Wang, Huixiao Le
arxiv-2106-00227.description: Abstract Owing to the development of research on local aggregation operators, dramatic breakthrough has been made in point cloud analysis models. However, existing local aggregation operators in the current literature fail to attach decent importance to the local information of the point cloud, which limits the power of the models.

arxiv-2108-07206.title: Proximity Perception in Human-Centered Robotics: A Survey on Sensing Systems and Applications
arxiv-2108-07206.creator: Stefan Escaida Navarro, Stephan Mühlbacher-Karrer, Hosam Alagi, Hubert Zangl, Keisuke Koyama, Björn Hein, Christian Duriez, and Joshua R. Smith
arxiv-2108-07206.description: Abstract Proximity perception is a technology that has the potential to play an essential role in the future of robotics. It can fulfill the promise of safe, robust, and autonomous systems in industry and everyday life, alongside humans, as well as in remote locations in space and underwater.

arxiv-2204-09904.title: Infographics Wizard: Flexible Infographics Authoring and Design Exploration Volume: 41 Issue: 3
arxiv-2204-09904.creator: Anjul Tyagi 1 Jian Zhao 2 Pushkar Patel 3 Swasti Khurana 3 Klaus Mueller 1 1 Computer Science Department, Stony Brook University, New York, USA 2 Cheriton School of Computer Science, University of Waterloo, Ontario, Canada 3 Indian Institute of Information Technology Vadodara, Gujarat, India
arxiv-2204-09904.description: Abstract Infographics are an aesthetic visual representation of information following specific design principles of human perception. Designing infographics can be a tedious process for non-experts and time-consuming, even for professional designers. With the help of designers, we propose a semi-automated infographic framework for general structured and flow-based infographic design generation.

arxiv-2307-06352.creator: Rodrigo Córdova Rosado, Brandon S. Hensley, Susan E. Clark, Adriaan J. Duivenvoorden, Zachary Atkins, Elia Stefano Battistelli, Steve K. Choi, Jo Dunkley, Carlos Hervías-Caimapo, Zack Li, Thibaut Louis, Sigurd Naess, Lyman A. Page, Bruce Partridge, Cristóbal Sifón, Suzanne T. Staggs, Cristian Vargas
arxiv-2307-06352.description: Abstract We present a cross-correlation analysis between 1 ​ ′ 1\arcmin resolution total intensity and polarization observations from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) at 150 and 220 GHz and 15 ​ ″ 15\arcsec mid-infrared photometry from the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer (WISE) over 107 12.5 ∘ × 12.5 ∘ 12.5^{\circ}\times 12.5^{\circ} patches of sky.

arxiv-2311-10444.title: The influence of Gaussian pinning on the melting scenario of a two-dimensional soft-disk system: First-Order versus Continuous Transition
arxiv-2311-10444.creator: Yu. D. Fomin, Eu. A. Gaiduk, E. N. Tsiok, V. N. Ryzhov
arxiv-2311-10444.description: Abstract Two-dimensional systems are realized experimentally as thin layers on a substrate. The substrate can have some imperfections (defects of the crystalline structure, chemical impurities, etc.), which demonstrate stronger interaction with the particles of the two-dimensional layer than the rest of the system. Such randomly distributed centers of strong interactions are called ”pinning centers”.

arxiv-2406-05207.title: ​Retrieval & Fine-Tuning for In-Context Tabular Models​
arxiv-2406-05207.creator: Valentin Thomas, Junwei Ma, Rasa Hosseinzadeh, Keyvan Golestan, Guangwei Yu, Maksims Volkovs, Anthony Caterini
arxiv-2406-05207.description: Abstract Tabular data is a pervasive modality spanning a wide range of domains, and the inherent diversity poses a considerable challenge for deep learning. Recent advancements using transformer-based in-context learning have shown promise on smaller and less complex datasets, but have struggled to scale to larger and more complex ones.

arxiv-2508-19050.title: Wake dynamics of finite-aspect-ratio rotating circular cylinders at low Reynolds number
arxiv-2508-19050.creator: Kai Zhang, Yong Cao, Hanfeng Wang, Yan Bao, Bin Zhao, Dai Zhou
arxiv-2508-19050.description: Abstract We perform direct numerical simulations of flows over finite-aspect-ratio rotating circular cylinders at a Reynolds number of 150 over a range of aspect ratios ( A ​ R = 2 − 12 AR=2-12 ) and rotation rates ( α = 0 − 5 \alpha=0-5 ), aiming at revealing the free-end effects on the wake dynamics and aerodynamic performance.

pmc-10587950.title: Comparison of the slow‐pull and aspiration methods of endobronchial ultrasound‐guided transbronchial needle aspiration for next‐generation sequencing‐compatible tissue collection in non‐small cell lung cancer
pmc-10587950.creator: Yukihito Kajita, Shuhei Teranishi, Tomoe Sawazumi, Haruka Watanabe, Satoshi Nagaoka, Anna Tanaka, Yuichirou Suzukawa, Yuto Motobayashi, Tomofumi Hirose, Chihiro Maeda, Kenichi Seki, Ken Tashiro, Nobuaki Kobayashi, Masaki Yamamoto, Makoto Kudo, Yoshiaki Inayama, Takeshi Kaneko
pmc-10587950.description: BackgroundPersonalized treatment for non‐small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has advanced rapidly, and elucidating the genetic changes that trigger this disease is crucial for appropriate treatment selection. Both slow‐pull and aspiration methods of endobronchial ultrasound‐guided transbronchial needle aspiration (EBUS‐TBNA) are accepted methods for collecting samples suitable for next‐generation sequencing (NGS) to examine driver gene mutations and translocations in NSCLC.

pmc-12504441.title: Synergistic effects of bioactive plant extract mixtures on methane reduction and rumen fermentation of eragrostis curvula hay in vitro
pmc-12504441.creator: Abiodun Mayowa Akanmu, Abubeker Hassen, Este van Marle-Köster, Hassan Azaizeh, Zeno Apostolides, Serge Yan Landau
pmc-12504441.description: Building on prior research indicating the methane-mitigating potential of specific medicinal plants for ruminant animals. This study aimed to investigate the associative effects of combining six medicinal plant extracts known for their methane-reducing properties: Aloe vera (AV), Carica papaya (CP), Azadirachta indica (AZ), Tithonia diversifolia (TD), Jatropha curcas (JA), and Moringa oleifera (MO).

pmc-13081646.title: Plasmid-mediated convergence of multidrug resistance and hypervirulence in community-acquired Klebsiella pneumoniae in Tianjin, China
pmc-13081646.creator: Donghang Li, Zhijuan Fan, Sumei Wang, Yanyan Su, Meng Yuan, Hui Fang, Rendong Wang, Huihui Gao, Hangming Bai, Daqing Mao, Yi Luo
pmc-13081646.description: BackgroundKlebsiella pneumoniae is a major bacterial pathogen responsible for community- and hospital-acquired infections. Although strains associated with hospital-acquired disease have been well described, the genomic and phenotypic characteristics of community-acquired K. pneumoniae among community-acquired isolates from this setting remain insufficiently understood.
